status_message: Historical environmental forcing not loaded — cdsapi package not installed. Run: pip install cdsapi
citation_or_dataset_identifier: Hersbach, H., et al. (2023): ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present. Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store (CDS). DOI: 10.24381/cds.adbb2d47
download_instructions: Run: python scripts/fetch_era5_wind.py --incident SIH-ENNORE-2017 (requires CDS API key in ~/.cdsapirc)

sample_schema._description: When loaded, each sample in the 'samples' array must follow this schema
sample_schema.wind_direction_deg: float, degrees (meteorological, direction from which wind blows)

notes: Do NOT substitute fictional constant wind values for this case. If ERA5 data is not loaded the application must display: 'Historical environmental forcing not loaded' and refuse to run drift backtracking.
